verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents background automation directly. Sandbox schedules run commands on a recurring cron, at a future datetime, or after a delay, with per-run execution history. Jobs run AI batch workflows as scheduled or on-demand tasks on serverless infrastructure. The Blaxel skill also lets an agent set these up through prompts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled runs work reliably unattended, and evidence of event-driven (non-time-based) triggers.
